creators.description: Organizational creator of record for the dataset, registered in the DataCite creator block with nameType Organizational. The consortium comprises the members of the AI-READI project across its participating institutions.

principal_investigator.name: Aaron Lee

affiliation.name: Department of Ophthalmology, University of Washington

principal_investigator.source_caveats: Two affiliations are recorded because two equally ranked tier-1 sources disagree: the FAIRhub structured metadata gives Aaron Lee's responsible-party and central contact affiliation as Washington University in St. Louis (ROR 01yc7t268), while the RO-Crate names him as principal investigator in the Department of Ophthalmology at the University of Washington. The email is the study central contact address recorded against his FAIRhub central-contact entry.

creators.source_caveats: The FAIRhub creator block records only one creator, "AI-READI Consortium", with nameType Organizational; the consortium itself carries no registry identifier in the declared sources, so no id is asserted for it. No affiliations are asserted: the ROR-identified institutions named in the bundle (Washington University in St. Louis, National Institutes of Health, California Medical Innovations Institute, Johns Hopkins University, Oregon Health & Science University, Stanford University, the University of Alabama at Birmingham, the University of California San Diego and the University of Washington) appear there as study sponsors, collaborators and locations rather than as affiliations of the consortium-as-creator.

data_governance.access_review_process: Access to the release requires logging in through a verified ID system, agreeing to use the data only for type 2 diabetes related research, and accepting the license terms, which set restrictions and obligations on data usage. The access route is published at https://fairhub.io/datasets/3/access. Access is granted by self-attestation rather than committee review: the FAIRhub access type for this release is PublicDownloadSelfAttestationRequired.
stewardship_roles: The data manager at each of the three collection sites is responsible for quality control of all data before upload to FAIRhub; the central project team performs standardization and dissemination processing; the AI-READI team supports and maintains the released dataset.
data_governance.notes: The BMJ Open protocol publication states that the requirements for the controlled access data sets were, at the time of writing, being developed by a Data Access Committee; no committee membership or contact for that body is given in the declared sources.
data_governance.source_caveats: Washington University in St. Louis is recorded as accountable organization on the strength of the FAIRhub managing-organization and lead-sponsor fields and the license, which names it as Licensor; the RO-Crate instead names the AI-READI Consortium as the data governance committee and places the principal investigator at the University of Washington.

d4d_fields.source_caveats: This record describes the publicly downloadable FAIRhub release of version 3.0.0 (DOI 10.60775/fairhub.3). Sources disagree on the expansion of the acronym: the FAIRhub study description and NIH RePORTER give "Artificial Intelligence Ready and Exploratory Atlas for Diabetes Insights", while the BMJ Open protocol and the Nature Metabolism comment give "Artificial Intelligence Ready and Equitable Atlas for Diabetes Insights"; the higher-ranked FAIRhub metadata is followed here. Sources also disagree on the lead institution: the FAIRhub structured metadata names Washington University in St. Louis as managing organization and lead sponsor and the license names it as Licensor, while the RO-Crate places the principal investigator in the Department of Ophthalmology at the University of Washington and NIH RePORTER records the awardee organization as the University of Washington; the two disagreeing tier-1 sources share the same rank, so both are recorded. Publisher is likewise disputed between the two tier-1 sources: the FAIRhub structured metadata gives the publisherName "FAIRhub" and the RO-Crate gives "AI-READI Consortium"; the FAIRhub position is followed in `publisher`, where the platform URL is recorded in the uriorcurie-ranged slot in place of the bare name the source states, and the RO-Crate value is noted here. Enrollment target is given as 4,000 participants by the FAIRhub study description, the NIH RePORTER abstract and both publications, but as 4,600 by the University of Washington IRB protocol.
